title: Generalizing Multimodal Foundational Models in Context-Driven Class Incremental Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.27298v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Class-Incremental Learning (CIL) aims to learn new classes continuously without forgetting the previously learned ones. Recent works in CIL have significantly advanced across various modalities; however, at the intersection of audio-visual modality, this problem remains underexplored. While representations from multimodal foundational models (MFMs) encapsulate rich static priors, our preliminary analysis shows that these representations struggle in incremental settings. Motivated by this, we propose a framework that generalizes frozen MFMs to audio-visual CIL. Specifically, we leverage their dense audio and visual representations and employ an attention-based contextual guidance module, in which the audio representations serve as task-stable contextual guidance for the visual representations, enabling effective class recognition in the incremental setting. translated_title: 在上下文驱动的类增量学习中泛化多模态基础模型
translated_abstract: 类增量学习（CIL）旨在持续学习新类别而不遗忘先前学习的类别。近年来，类增量学习的研究在各种模态上取得了显著进展；然而，在视听模态的交叉领域，这一问题仍未得到充分探索。虽然多模态基础模型（MFMs）的表示包含了丰富的静态先验，但我们的初步分析表明，这些表示在增量学习场景中表现不佳。受此启发，我们提出了一个将冻结的多模态基础模型泛化到视听类增量学习的框架。具体而言，我们利用其密集的音频和视觉表示，并采用一个基于注意力的上下文引导模块，其中音频表示作为视觉表示的任务稳定上下文引导，从而在增量学习场景中实现有效的类别识别。为了进一步缓解灾难性遗忘并保持跨任务的稳定性，……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一个框架，将冻结的多模态基础模型泛化到视听类增量学习中，利用音频表示作为视觉表示的任务稳定上下文引导模块，以实现有效的类别识别并缓解灾难性遗忘。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a framework that generalizes frozen multimodal foundational models to audio-visual class-incremental learning, employing audio representations as task-stable contextual guidance for visual representations via an attention-based module to enable effective class recognition and mitigate catastrophic forgetting.
